CREATE_REMINDER.description: CREATE_REMINDER: Create a time-based reminder that will notify the user in the future about something they should remember. This is not a task to complete and not a meeting with other people.
examples: remind me to call mom tomorrow
don’t let me forget to submit the report
I need a reminder for my medication
set a reminder so I don’t forget

LIST_REMINDERS.description: LIST_REMINDERS: Show all active reminders. This is a simple list of reminders, not a summary of tasks or meetings.

DELETE_REMINDER.description: DELETE_REMINDER: Permanently delete or cancel an existing reminder so it will no longer notify the user. This is not marking something as done.
examples: remove the reminder about the meeting
I don’t need that reminder anymore

CREATE_TASK.description: CREATE_TASK: Create a task or todo item that the user intends to complete. Tasks are not time-based alerts and are not meetings.
examples: create a task to fix the bug
add a task to review the code
add this to my todo list

LIST_TASKS.description: LIST_TASKS: Show all active tasks or todo items. This does not include reminders or meetings.

COMPLETE_TASK.description: COMPLETE_TASK: Mark an existing task or todo item as completed or done. The task remains in history and is not deleted or removed.

DELETE_TASK.description: DELETE_TASK: Permanently delete or remove a task from the task list. This is not the same as completing or finishing a task.
examples: I don’t need that task anymore

SCHEDULE_MEETING.description: SCHEDULE_MEETING: Schedule a meeting or appointment that occurs at a specific time and may include other participants. This is not a task or reminder.
examples: plan a meeting with the team
add a meeting to my calendar

LIST_MEETINGS.description: LIST_MEETINGS: Show upcoming scheduled meetings or calendar events. This does not include tasks or reminders.

CANCEL_MEETING.description: CANCEL_MEETING: Cancel or delete a scheduled meeting so it no longer appears on the calendar.

SHOW_SUMMARY.description: SHOW_SUMMARY: Show a high-level overview or summary of tasks, reminders, and meetings together. This is not a detailed list of a single item type.
examples: what do I need to know today

HELP.description: HELP: Show help information explaining what the system can do and how to use available commands.
